methods.name: HasEnrolledFingerprints
methods.description: Checks if device has Enrolled Fingerprints.

methods.name: HasFingerprintPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has granted the app permission to use the Fingerprint Sensor.

methods.name: HasFingerprintSensor
methods.description: Checks if device has a Fingerprint Sensor.

methods.name: IsKeyguardSecure
methods.description: Checks if the Keyguard(Lock Screen) is Secure. This is required to be able to use Fingerprint Authentication

events.name: AuthenticationError
events.description: Called when an unrecoverable error has been encountered and the operation is complete.

events.name: AuthenticationFailed
events.description: Called when a fingerprint is valid but not recognized.

events.name: AuthenticationHelp
events.description: Called when a recoverable error has been encountered during authentication.

events.name: AuthenticationSucceeded
events.description: Called when a fingerprint is recognized.
